certificate.description: The NFX350 Network Services Platform is Juniper Network's secure, automated, software-driven customer premises equipment (CPE) devices that deliver virtualized network and security services on demand. The NFX Network Services Platform delivers capacity, performance, and scale to larger enterprise organizations and service providers who are looking to run multiple services on one platform.
